errors.text_span: Секторите са разположени в кръга в низходящ ред по големина, започвайки от най-големия вляво надолу.
errors.evidence: The description incorrectly states that the sectors are arranged in descending order of size. In reality, the sectors are not ordered by size. Following the sectors clockwise from the top, the percentages are 16.7%, 21.4%, 26.2%, 31.0%, and 4.8%, which is not a descending sequence.
